correctness.rationale: For each voter, the attacker copy's conditional rank is uniform on the candidate's probability interval, or equals its collapsed rank if the mass is zero. The probability of beating both independent defender ranks averages to ell²+ell z+z²/3. Averaging against the candidate weights integrates rank² on [0,1], giving sum D(x)H_x(D)=1/3. Existence at this value can also be seen directly: the continuous simplex map D↦(D+g)/(1+sum g) with g_x=max(H_x−1/3,0) has a Brouwer fixed point. If sum g>0 there, every supported candidate has payoff above 1/3, contradicting the identity. Thus stability is exactly H_x≤1/3 for all x, with equality on support. If a strict winner A is omitted, singleton support makes H_A>1/2, and for interior B,C support equality gives x=D(B)=(3u−n)/n, u the integer B-over-C count. With k=floor(n/2)+1, the counts t of A-first ballots and b,c of A-middle ballots satisfy t+b,t+c≥k and t≥2k−n. If t≥k then H_A≥k/n>1/3. Otherwise H_A≥[(2k−n)+(n−k)(x²+(1−x)²)]/n. For even n≤12 this is at least 3/8; for odd n≥3 the integer grid gives |x−1/2|≥3/(2n), and the resulting bound decreases to 446/1331>1/3 at n=11. At n=1 the strict winner tops the ballot and omission gives H_A=1. For the given 13 ballots the payoff triple is (703/2197,1/3,1/3), with both pairwise margins 7–6. For any stable lottery on this profile the B inequality yields b≥5/13, where b denotes its mass. At each such b the C payoff decreases strictly with its mass c over c≤1−b, since its derivative is at most (8−23b)/39<0. The minimum at c=1−b exceeds 1/3 by b(13b−5)/39 unless b=5/13. So the displayed lottery is unique. Fresh exact anonymous-profile enumeration found no omissions through 12, and 2 at 13 among 2688 strict-A-winner profiles and 1288 interior stationary pairs. It corroborates the bound, and does not assert uniqueness of the profile.
residual_risks: The minimax level and grid calculation depend on the independent-draw uniform-copy rule, strict ballots, and equally weighted voters. No bound for additional alternatives or a distinct-committee model has been checked.
